verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an AI video-generation tool, but the evidence shows no documented way to act on many videos or projects in a single operation. The nearby features are adjacent rather than bulk operations: review notes on one video can be sent together, one project can post to several platforms in one command, and the agent limit spans projects without any batch command or UI behind it. Internal parallel agents working on parts of a single video are also not a user-facing bulk operation.
